description: Asks, on a writable copy, how DROP and ALTER ... DROP answer for missing and dependent objects through Database.Execute (dbFailOnError), each followed by DBEngine.Errors: DROP TABLE of an unknown table, with IF EXISTS, with two names, with a bracketed name, with CASCADE and RESTRICT, of a table that is the parent of a relationship (Dp1 over Dp2) and then of the child first; DROP INDEX of the primary key behind a relationship; DROP CONSTRAINT, DROP COLUMN, DROP VIEW and DROP PROCEDURE of an unknown name. The TableDefs names and the Relations count are read at the end. Fixture r-def-expr-sql-main is opened on a writable fresh copy through DAO.DBEngine.120; engine version and the loaded modules (once) are recorded; each recordset reads Name, Type and Value of every field.
retentionNote: Designed r-def-expr-sql probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.
